result.title: Routing Beyond Task Categories: A Cost-Aware LAB-Bench Study
result.comment: 21 pages, 3 figures. Reproduction archive at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24220501
result.summary: We tested whether features of biology questions or of a model's first answer can improve accuracy within an inference budget. In a LAB-Bench pilot, we compared a category router with one that adds six structural features. Neither reached the primary 80% accuracy target on development. At the 50% and 60% secondary targets, both chose Haiku for all 120 held-out questions and scored 71/120. We then froze a new comparison before collecting responses on 144 additional questions. Semantic routing scored 86/144. A policy that could defer after reading Haiku's answer scored 87/144. Both stayed within the inference budget of USD 0.678 per 1,000 queries. Against a 95% Haiku and 5% GPT mixture, the accuracy gains were 0.66 percentage points for semantic routing and 1.35 points for deferral. The paired 95% intervals were [-0.28,2.25] and [-0.14,3.47] points. A simple rule that escalated Haiku nonanswers scored 92/144 at USD 0.710 per 1,000 queries, above the budget. A retrospective nonanswer rule with a calibration-selected escalation probability gave an expected 85.63/144. At the learned deferral policy's observed inference cost, post hoc interpolation gave an expected 86.14/144. In a later development check, Astra and Gemini each scored 30/40. The best tested policy in each router family matched that score. The pair covered 33/40 in hindsight. The routers missed the 32/40 criterion, so the proposed 120-question evaluation did not start.

AI.brief_summary: 在 LAB-Bench 生物题上检验推理预算内的模型路由：比较类别路由与加入六个结构特征的路由，并测试语义路由、读取首个答案后可推迟（defer）的策略与非答案升级规则对准确率和每千次查询成本的影响。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「读完首个回答再决定是否追加更强模型」的 deferral 策略，可能与 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的继续计算与停止决策、计算价值判断相关，可供核查；但属纯文本路由研究，收益仅为约 1 个百分点的边际提升，向多模态 latent 推理的迁移需较多推断。
